description: Round-3.1 pinned generators from ReCLamO-Harness PR #64 (commit d816814). All 8 tasks pass the 2,111-probe scorer battery at evals/independent/audit/scripts/scorer_battery.py. Multivac.py is the only file that changed vs round-3; the generate() function is byte-identical for every size x seeds 0-9 (scorer-only change).
round3_1_note: Multivac.py score() now accepts a field label (Status/Priority/State) after the description, optionally behind a dash/bar/bullet or inside '(Status: ...)'; the status window ends at a paragraph break (later history is not a hedge); and the requirement id is matched whole (R14 no longer matches R142). 0.2 -> 1.0 on a correct 'R142: <desc> — Status: Pending' answer. Port of ReCLamO-Harness PR #64, commit d816814.
